verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs state directly that installing its GitHub App grants the agent access to your repositories with no complex setup, which matches the story. Related docs confirm the agent can manage repositories, create branches and commit code once connected. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the install flow and repository/permission scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration that the install is truly one-click.

support.subject: As a developer, I can grant an agent access to my repositories with a one-click install, without complex setup

citations.quote: Install the GitHub App to grant the agent access to your repositories. No complex setup required.
Review PRs, suggest changes, comment on issues, create branches, commit code, and manage repositories.
Control whether the codegen agent is able to create pull requests in your repositories in response to user requests.
